answer: MACI-style secret key changes for the juror reef. Each grader registers a quill signing key; grades are encrypted to a coordinator who publishes only a ZK-proven tally. Any grader may silently rotate its key with a later encrypted message that voids earlier grades, so a sybil broker renting a saffron of accounts can never verify its puppets graded as paid. Without verifiable obedience, rented identities are worthless to a ring; only self-run clones remain, which other checks price.
